flaps._comment: A300-600R slat/flap system uses combined slat/flap configurations: CONF 0/0, 15/0, 15/15, 30/20, and 30/40. Speed values are based on public docket material and remain pending add-on-specific verification.

grades._comment: A300-600R widebody transport bands aligned with the existing A310 family profile.

telemetry._comment: No A300-specific LVAR is active. Standard SimConnect remains the live telemetry path because exact aircraft-specific readback semantics lack vendor documentation and in-simulator verification.

controls._comment: No custom cockpit writes are active. Only Flight Fabric's narrow standard gear/flaps surface fallback is allowed.
